title: Sophisticated Middle-earth
description: A datapack to modify Sophisticated backpack and storage mod craft for Middle-earth mod
body:
This Datapack Bring compatibility between Middle Earth and Sophisticated Backpack and Storage.

All the item of Sophisticated Series can now be craft from Middle Earth.

# Equivalent
- Netherite -> Mithril
- Diamond -> Steel
- Redstone -> Agate,Citrine or quartz Shard
# Backpack
As you can't get a jukbox in Middle-Earth there is no way to craft the upgrade.
# Storage
The chest and barrels now require a honeycomb instead of a redstone torch for the craft.
